冷欣眉毛不由得一挑。

“真的可以商量吗？”

林佳一时无语，冷欣随后笑了笑。

“你又说的不算！我还是自己寻找吧，不跟你们一起了，免得麻烦！”

胡九郎沉声道：

“既然你执意如此，我们也不拦着你，但是你要记住，这里很危险，一旦遇到什么情况，一定要及时发出信号，我们会尽力帮你。另外，不要擅自闯入正房后面的房间，那里的阴邪之气最浓郁，很有可能有什么危险的。”

冷欣没有说话，只是冷冷地看了众人一眼，转身就朝着院子西侧走去，脚步匆匆，显然是想尽快在院子里找到陆明的踪迹。

汐汐看着冷欣的背影，小声说道：

“这个姑娘也太固执了，这里这么危险，她一个人，真的没问题吗？我们要不要跟着她，保护她一下？”

胡九郎摇了摇头，沉声道：

“不用，她既然执意要独自寻找，我们也不能勉强，而且我们现在最重要的，是调查聚阴阵的秘密，只要我们查明了真相找到陆明的下落，自然就能帮到她。杨先生，你再仔细看看这个聚阴阵，能不能找到一些关于上古邪物和阴尘阁阴谋的线索？”

杨树远点了点头，再次走到房间中央的凹槽旁边，蹲下身仔细观察着凹槽里面的污渍和周围的符文，指尖轻轻拂过凹槽表面，指尖注入一丝真炁，凹槽里面的黑色污渍，顿时泛起淡淡的黑气，与周围的阴邪之气交织在一起。

杨树远神色凝重地说道：

“这些污渍，是阴邪之气和上古邪物的气息混合而成的，而且从这些污渍的浓度来看，那些人在这里滋养上古邪物已经有很长一段时间了，上古邪物的实力应该已经很强了。另外这些符文，拼凑起来，和令牌秘文上的符文有很多相似之处，看来这里的聚阴阵，就是为了掩盖更大的阴谋，‘以什么之血，献什么上古邪物’，这里的‘血’，很有可能是某种特殊的血脉，而‘上古邪物’，很有不知道在什么地方，只有破解了聚阴阵进入他们的内部，才会知道！”

杨童听完心中不由得一动，连忙说道：

“特殊的血脉？会不会和我的前世有关？幻境中，我和九郎的前世，似乎都与这些事有着千丝万缕的联系，而且令牌秘文里，也记录了我们前世的事情，说不定，这里的‘血’，就是我的血脉，或者是九郎的血脉？”

杨树远摇了摇头，缓缓说道：

“不好说，目前还没有足够的线索，只能确定这特殊的血脉和上古邪物的觉醒有关，小胡，你可能破解此阵？”

胡九郎却在这个时候犹豫了起来。

“这个……”

杨树远看到胡九郎似乎有些为难，张嘴正要说话，忽然传来一阵打斗声，伴随着冷欣的呵斥声和嘶吼声。

众人顿时神色一紧，快速冲出正房，朝着打斗声传来的方向跑去。

Leng Xin couldn't help but raise her eyebrows.

"Is it really negotiable?"

Lin Jia was speechless for a moment, and then Leng Xin smiled.

"What you said doesn't count! I'd better look for it myself instead of going with you, so as not to cause trouble!"

Hu Jiulang said in a deep voice:

"Since you insist on doing so, we won't stop you, but you have to remember that this place is very dangerous. If you encounter any situation, you must send a signal in time and we will try our best to help you. In addition, do not break into the room behind the main house without permission. The evil spirit there is the strongest, and it is very likely to be dangerous."

Leng Xin didn't speak, she just glanced at everyone coldly, turned around and walked towards the west side of the yard, her footsteps hurried, obviously wanting to find Lu Ming in the yard as soon as possible.

Xixi looked at Leng Xin's back and whispered:

"This girl is too stubborn. It's so dangerous here. Is it really okay for her to be alone? Should we follow her and protect her?"

Hu Jiulang shook his head and said in a deep voice:

"No, since she insists on searching alone, we can't force it. And the most important thing for us now is to investigate the secret of the Yin Gathering Formation. As long as we find out the truth and find Lu Ming's whereabouts, we can naturally help her. Mr. Yang, if you take a closer look at the Yin Gathering Formation, can you find any clues about the ancient evil objects and the Yin Chen Pavilion conspiracy?"

Yang Shuyuan nodded, walked to the groove in the center of the room again, squatted down and carefully observed the stains in the groove and the surrounding runes. His fingertips gently brushed the surface of the groove, and a trace of true energy was injected into the fingertips. The black stains in the groove suddenly gave off a faint black air, intertwined with the surrounding evil aura.

Yang Shuyuan said solemnly:

"These stains are a mixture of the evil spirit and the breath of ancient evil things. Judging from the concentration of these stains, those people have been nourishing ancient evil things here for a long time. The strength of ancient evil things should be very strong. In addition, these runes, when put together, have many similarities with the runes on the secret script of the token.Similar, it seems that the Yin Gathering Formation here is to cover up a larger conspiracy, 'what kind of blood, what ancient evil thing to sacrifice?', the 'blood' here is probably some kind of special blood, and the 'ancient evil thing' is probably not known where. Only by cracking the Yin Gathering Formation and entering their interior will we know!"

Yang Tong couldn't help but feel moved after hearing this, and said quickly:

"Special bloodline? Could it be related to my past life? In the fantasy world, the past lives of Kuro and I seem to be inextricably linked to these things, and the secret text of the token also records the events of our past lives. Maybe the 'blood' here is my bloodline, or Jiuro's bloodline?"

Yang Shuyuan shook his head and said slowly:

"It's hard to say. There are not enough clues yet. We can only confirm that this special bloodline is related to the awakening of ancient evil things. Xiao Hu, can you crack this formation?"

Hu Jiulang hesitated at this time.

"This..."

Yang Shuyuan saw that Hu Jiulang seemed a little embarrassed. He opened his mouth and was about to speak when suddenly there was a sound of fighting, accompanied by Leng Xin's scolding and roaring.

Everyone's expressions suddenly became tense, and they quickly rushed out of the main room and ran towards the direction where the sound of fighting came from.
